gloss: uncollected receivable; outstanding amount owed to one

definitions.gloss: uncollected receivable; money still owed to one; accounts receivable
definitions.explanation: Money that has been earned or billed but not yet received. In everyday use it is an amount a customer still owes; in accounting it is an asset recorded for revenue already recognized.

examples.japanese: {未収金|みしゅうきん}が{増|ふ}えている。
{先月|せんげつ}の{未収金|みしゅうきん}をやっと{回収|かいしゅう}した。
examples.english: We finally collected last month's outstanding receivables.

examples.japanese: {取引先|とりひきさき}の{倒産|とうさん}で、{多額|たがく}の{未収金|みしゅうきん}が{残|のこ}ってしまった。
examples.english: A client's bankruptcy left us with a large amount of uncollected receivables.

examples.japanese: {経理|けいり}{担当者|たんとうしゃ}は、{月末|げつまつ}ごとに{未収金|みしゅうきん}の{一覧表|いちらんひょう}を{作|つく}っている。
examples.english: The accounting staff prepares a list of outstanding receivables at the end of each month.

notes:
Formed from {未|み} (not yet) plus {収|しゅう} (to collect, to take in) plus {金|きん} (money). It is standard vocabulary in accounting and billing; in casual speech people say まだ{払|はら}ってもらっていないお{金|かね} instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未収金|みしゅうきん}が{残|のこ}る: for a receivable to remain outstanding
- {未収金|みしゅうきん}を{回収|かいしゅう}する: to collect an amount owed
- {未収金|みしゅうきん}を{計上|けいじょう}する: to record a receivable on the books

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未払|みはら}い{金|きん}: unpaid amount — money you owe, the mirror image of {未収金|みしゅうきん}
- {売掛金|うりかけきん}: accounts receivable — narrower; only credit sales of goods or services
- {滞納|たいのう}: delinquency, arrears — stresses that a payment is overdue
